description: Verify a factual claim against specific public evidence URLs before an agent repeats it or acts on it. The tool checks whether supplied keywords appear in each fetched source and reports per-source evidence. It does not perform open-ended search, semantic contradiction analysis, or prove a claim true when a page is silent; choose direct evidence URLs and interpret the result as a support signal. Fetched pages are cached for 5 minutes.

claim.description: Plain-language claim to verify, for example 'AWS Business support includes 24/7 phone support'.

evidence_urls.description: One to ten public documentation, pricing, policy, or support URLs that are likely to contain direct evidence for the claim.

keywords.description: Keywords or short phrases that should appear on supporting pages. Matching is case-insensitive substring matching, so choose phrases that are likely to appear verbatim.

name: verify_claim

accessible.description: True when the evidence page could be fetched.

cached.description: True when the page body came from the 5-minute cache.

error.description: Fetch error when the evidence page could not be checked.

keywordsMatched.description: Subset of supplied keywords that were found on the page.

keywordsTotal.description: Total number of keywords the tool looked for on this page.

matchRatio.description: Matched-keyword ratio for this source, from 0 to 1.

supports.description: True when the page met the current support threshold of at least half of the supplied keywords.

verdict.description: Aggregate verdict across all supplied sources.

confidence.description: Share of sources that supported the claim.

contradicting.description: Number of sources not marked as supporting the claim.

summary.description: High-level verdict derived from the supporting-source ratio: all sources supporting => CONFIRMED, none => UNCONFIRMED, majority => LIKELY TRUE, otherwise LIKELY FALSE.

supporting.description: Number of sources marked as supporting the claim.

total.description: Total number of evidence sources checked.

title: Claim Support Check
